'''Shannon Huecker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Lexington tournament]] on 2 December 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court with Mobilization Points and Power Of The Hutt]], according to Matt Baker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1522">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ lexington-ky-12-2-00], DeckTech (Matt "kjerg" Baker, 10 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
